stem: ![](asset:P000254-stem-1)An artillery gun is mounted on a trolley moving with a speed of 10 m/s. The gun can fire shells at a speed of 50 m/s. It is placed with its barrel making an angle of $53{^\circ}$ with the horizontal. If a shell is fired then what will be its range as observed from the ground?

assets.alt: A cannon fixed on a flat cart moving to the right at 10 m/s; the barrel points up at 53° to the horizontal.
